name: cache-keeper
description: A strip above the prompt: prompt-cache countdown, context size, usage limits, API-equivalent cost, cold-cache price, and one-click Handoff & Clear.

defaultWindowMinutes.title: Default cache window (minutes)
defaultWindowMinutes.description: Used until the real cache TTL is detected from the session. /cache-window overrides it.

warnMinutes.title: Warn before cold (minutes)
warnMinutes.description: Send a notification this many minutes before the cache goes cold.

inputPricePerMTok.title: Input price override ($ per million tokens)
inputPricePerMTok.description: 0 = use the built-in list-price table for the session's model.
